title: Shared-kernel envelope contracts and catalog reference integrity

independence.cross_vendor_exception: Not satisfied: every assigned run is Anthropic claude-opus-5. The Decision Register permits a single-vendor fallback only as an explicit recorded exception. Five separate runs with distinct capability declarations, none reviewing its own work, is that fallback - it is not equivalent to cross-vendor review, and runs sharing a vendor and a model share a correlated blind spot.

required_human_authorities: Product Owner disposition of RFC-2026-004 before the manual merge described in RFC-2026-002
purpose: Close defect D3 - two committed catalog $refs that resolve to a path which does not exist, on the two Candidate envelopes that carry every domain event and background job - behind a standing CI guard, and materialize three Draft shared-kernel contracts from the Sprint 0A baseline without inventing contract semantics or advancing any freeze level.

include: A standing catalog reference-integrity guard: every external $ref resolves on disk, no $ref escapes the catalog, every manifest-declared file exists, every fixture on disk is declared
Correction of the two broken tenant_context $refs in CTR-EVT-001 and CTR-JOB-001, recorded in-file
CTR-API-001, CTR-PAG-001 and CTR-IDM-001 schema, manifest and synthetic valid/invalid fixtures
Deterministic acceptance and negative-case tests for all three new contracts
exclude: Contract freeze-level advancement, contract-catalog/shared-kernel/index.json, production schema, migrations, RLS implementation, provider SDKs, credentials, customer data, network calls, Gate G0 approval and any merge authorization

contracts_produced: CTR-API-001, CTR-PAG-001, CTR-IDM-001 materialized at Draft only; no freeze-level advancement

authorized_cross_package_amendments: contract-catalog/shared-kernel/ctr-evt-001/schema.json - correct tenant_context $ref from ../../ctr-ten-001/schema.json to ../ctr-ten-001/schema.json and record x-amended-by (RFC-2026-004 decision 2). Corrective, not anticipatory: the reference is broken today.

acceptance_criteria: The reference-integrity guard fails on the pre-fix tree naming both offending files and the paths they resolve to, and passes after the correction. The guard was written before the fix.
Every external $ref in every catalog schema resolves to a file that exists, and no $ref escapes contract-catalog/.
Every cataloged entry cites its baseline Contract ID, owner, version, status and source references without inventing contract semantics.
All fixtures are synthetic, with at least two valid and two negative cases per contract; every valid fixture is accepted and every negative fixture is rejected.
No valid fixture carries a public URL in status_ref, deep_link_ref, result_ref or input_ref.
The index still reports 4 Candidate and 10 Draft after materialization: materializing a Draft contract does not promote it.
The cross-package correction is limited to the two $ref string literals plus an x-amended-by record, and changes no field, semantics, version or freeze level.
npm run check passes on pinned Node 24.20.0 / npm 11.19.0 and the executed-test floor is met.
required_tests: Catalog $ref resolvability against disk, and no $ref escaping the catalog
Manifest-declared schema and fixtures exist; every fixture on disk is declared
Draft status preserved for all three new contracts and in the index
Valid/invalid fixture acceptance for CTR-API-001, CTR-PAG-001 and CTR-IDM-001

Negative cases: success payload carried together with an error, decodable offset cursor, sort without a tiebreaker, idempotency scope missing workspace, payload-hash format, completed without result_ref, public reference leakage
Repository protocol, ownership, role-separation, capability and secret-scan checks
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. Reverting restores the two broken $refs exactly and removes the three Draft contract directories and both new test files. No persisted data, provider state, credential, migration or customer-data effect exists.
open_blockers: RFC-2026-004 is Proposed and requires Product Owner disposition before the RFC-2026-002 manual merge.

The cross-package correction to two WP-0A-CON-001 outputs requires an acknowledgement countersigned by that package's Integration Owner /root/r0_steward, an OpenAI Codex run unavailable in this session. Both schemas record acknowledgement_status: pending.

This package depends on WP-0A-A0-002, which is itself unmerged and whose RFC-2026-003 is Proposed. Without it the ownership validator rejects this package's paths and CI does not execute the contract tests at all.

CTR-API-001 auth rules, OpenAPI generation (API-006) and optimistic-concurrency preconditions (API-004) are declared out of scope and remain open before freeze; the cursor encoding and signing algorithm for CTR-PAG-001 and the idempotency store, lock strategy and retention window for CTR-IDM-001 are likewise deliberately unspecified.
prefer_cross_vendor_review is not satisfied; see independence.cross_vendor_exception. Recorded as an exception, not waived.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; this package is restricted to reversible, synthetic-only work.
